comments.note: WP-005 scope listed 'add integration test for multi-target build with custom target using outputDirs config' — no such test exists. The resolveOutputDir() code path that merges outVscode/outClaudeCode into the outputDirs map is entirely untested. Only the deprecated-field backward-compat path is exercised. Recommend adding a test that uses outputDirs['vscode'] and a custom target's outputDirs entry to close this gap before a GA release.

defaultRegistry is a module-level mutable singleton. TargetRegistry has no unregister() or reset() method. If a future test calls defaultRegistry.register() for a new name, subsequent tests in the same file that assert names().length === 3 will fail. Vitest worker isolation prevents cross-file contamination, but intra-file mutation remains a latent risk. Consider documenting that consumers must not mutate defaultRegistry in tests, or add a freeze/snapshot mechanism.

No code is clean and consistent — code is well-structured. target-registry.test.ts uses isolated TargetRegistry instances via beforeEach/afterEach correctly for all mutable tests, keeping defaultRegistry assertions read-only. This is the right pattern.

summary: Reviewed three test files added by WP-005: tests/targets/target-registry.test.ts (33 tests), tests/builders/target-variable-injection.test.ts (12 tests), tests/builders/da-computed-fields.test.ts (7 tests). No blocking issues found. Code quality is high across all three files. Tests are well-structured with correct isolation patterns, good helper factoring, and clear AC traceability. No Fix-Forward changes applied. Four observations recorded (1 documentation-forward medium, 1 documentation-forward low, 2 low-priority improvements).

comments.note: [documentation-forward] tests/targets/target-registry.test.ts file-header lists 'AC-3', 'AC-4', 'AC-5' referencing WP-003's internal acceptance criteria — but these are not WP-005's ACs. Future maintainers reading this file will be confused about which WP the AC numbers belong to. Add a comment clarifying 'AC-3/AC-4/AC-5 below refer to WP-003 acceptance criteria (the implementation WP for TargetRegistry)' or renumber to match WP-005 ACs.

[documentation-forward] The resolveOutputDir() code path for suiteConfig.outputDirs (the non-deprecated map path) is entirely unexercised by WP-005 tests — all integration tests use the outVscode/outClaudeCode deprecated fields. QA flagged this gap; it should be documented as a known coverage hole in the test file (or addressed before GA) so the Documentation agent can add an appropriate callout in docs/api.md or the test README.

da-computed-fields.test.ts createSuite() helper calls mkdir() for outVscode and outClaudeCode directories, but makeConfig() sets check: true — writes are disabled, so these directories are never used. The mkdir calls are dead work. Consider removing the mkdir calls for those paths from createSuite() (the srcDir subdirectories must still be created). Non-behavioral, no impact on test correctness.

Inconsistent temp-dir management patterns across the two builder test files: target-variable-injection.test.ts uses a beforeEach/afterEach lifecycle with a single testTmpDir per test; da-computed-fields.test.ts uses a makeTempDir() accumulator array flushed in afterEach. Both patterns are correct and safe. A consistent convention across test files would lower the cognitive overhead for future contributors adding tests in either file.
